title: Still happy after a month
text: Still happy after a month. So far, happy with this humidifier. The light is very dim. Ran on low for over 24hours without running out of water. Quiet, good amount of mist. Only 3 levels you must toogle to access.  Top fill tank is nice. If you have big hands, xxl glove size, this would be difficult to clean.

product_metadata.title: Mikikin Cool Mist Humidifier for Bedroom, Ultrasonic Humidifiers for Baby Large Room Home, 4.5L Top Fill Desk Humidifiers with Three Mist Modes, 360° Nozzle, Auto Shut-Off, Lasts Up to 30 Hours - Blue
features: 【ULTRASONIC COOL MIST HUMIDIFIER】Safely moisturizes the dry air in your room to relieves stress and create a comfortable and breathable living atmosphere at home. The 360° rotating nozzle allows mist to be dispersed in any direction, providing an even level of humidity, create a soothing, comfortable environment.

【WHISPER-QUIET DEEP SLEEP MODE】The air humidifier works almost no noise which offers maximum relaxation during sleeping or working. Sensitive touch buttons help you easily change operating modes. Simply press it for 3s to turn off the nightlight. Enjoy all night mist and rest easily. Perfect for your baby and a disturbance-free sleep at night.

【LONG-LASTING & AUTO SHUT-OFF】Design with a large capacity water tank of 4.5L, it could release fine and clean mist up to 30 hours. You can enjoy whole night sleep, frees you from refilling water frequently. Having an automatic shut-off function, greatly ensure your safety and preventing unit damage when it runs out of water.

【EASY TO REFILL & CLEAN】A top-filling design makes the air humidifier is easily refilled and cleaned. Simply open the top cover to add clean water directly to the water tank through the wide opening top. No need to disassemble the device to fill it with water.【BUILT-IN ESSENTIAL OIL TRAY】Allow you to enjoy the mist and fragrance at the same time. Please drop essential oil on the sponge ring inside the aromatherapy box that is under the nozzle. Do NOT add it into water tank or base chamber.

【PRECISE MIST OUTPUT CONTROL】Three humidity levels allow you to adjust the moisturizing speed by choosing a low, medium, or high setting. Simply one touch to set much more precise and desired humidity level in your living room. Effectively provide ideal coverage for bedroom, living room, nursery, office and so on.
